evidence.title: Ghostex README.md
evidence.locator: Features; Supported agents; Install; Credits; License
evidence.finding: Ghostex provides local native agent sessions, mobile remote access, coordinators, scheduled prompts, worktrees, searchable session history, diffs and optional plugins. iOS access is via TestFlight.

evidence.title: Ghostex LICENSE
evidence.finding: MIT applies to Ghostex source at the pinned revision; embedded third-party projects have their own terms.

evidence.title: Ghostex v11.1.0 release
evidence.finding: Release published 8 November 2026 with desktop and mobile artifacts.

evidence.title: Ghostex skills/ghostex-help/references/settings.md
evidence.locator: Privacy; Collaboration; Cloud Boxes; Git actions
evidence.finding: Anonymous analytics is enabled by default with a toggle. Shared chats allow named guest messages with approval or direct Send mode and expiry. Agentbox can use Docker locally or on an SSH server; cloud boxes use users own Instabox/Boat accounts.

evidence.title: Ghostex skills/ghostex-help/references/features.md
evidence.locator: Changes view; Remote machines, web, and mobile
evidence.finding: Changes view supports commit/push/create PR, line feedback and revert. Remote web and phone clients connect to the host.

evidence.title: Ghostex account-login command
evidence.locator: server/src/ghostex_cli/account_login.rs line 8 (HELP) and server/src/ghostex_cli/account_login_codex.rs lines 1-3 and 30 (HELP), release v11.3.0 commit be391fd; README.md line 140
evidence.finding: Settings > Accounts runs ghostex account-login, which signs in to a Claude or Codex account through the provider's browser login and saves each as a separate profile (cswap or xswap) for automatic account switching; the README advertises Claude and Codex usage limits with automatic account switching.

evidence.title: Ghostex Antigravity support at v11.3.0
evidence.finding: Ghostex v11.3.0 includes Antigravity CLI in its agent launch path with model and effort launch options.
